__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

installUploadedPlugin.description: `programs` chooses the program for each of a form plugin's program keys (a key left out keeps the program it is already bound to); `takeOver` names document types whose existing entry, installed by no plugin, the plugin may take over; `blankOldUi` names taken-over types whose form on sites still running the old client may go blank, because the type carries no legacy UI schema (refused otherwise).
